en.t:
Elevate Dental Care with A.I.
Personalized. Predictive. Safe.
en.p1: While your dental professional has assessed your suitability for dental implants, our new SimS software technology from Shanghai Villanelle Life Co., Ltd. offers additional insights to identify any potential oral health issues. In essence, this means you now have the added reassurance of a high-tech risk assessment for dental implants, utilizing world-class technology.
en.p2: After your panoramic dental X-ray images are uploaded to the SimS system, our advanced medical Artificial Intelligence (AI) instantly analyzes your images to detect early signs of potential oral health issues, such as:
en.t3: What does the AI technology actually do?
en.p3: Fundamentally, your panoramic dental X-ray images are digitally evaluated using our most advanced deep learning model to ascertain if there are any underlying oral health conditions. A SimS report will precisely highlight any areas of concern and furnish you with an oral health ranking compared to others in your age demographic.
en.p4: SimS, powered by our latest deep learning model, assists in the early detection of oral health issues (including chronic diseases). Any conditions detected will be included in your report, which you can discuss with your dentist. Your oral health is crucial – and early detection and intervention can make a significant impact, and in some cases, may even prevent implant failure. Of course, if you have any questions – just ask your dentist and they will be happy to assist.
